sections.title: Automation: Approval Matrix Configuration
paragraphs: Approval Types are used within the matrices to indicate how the object should move through the approval process

Multiple approval Matrix Configurations may be associated with each approval object. The values within each matrix configuration determine when it is utilized in the approval process. Approval matrices are setup utilizing an excel import function

sections.title: Automation: Approval Matrix Excel Template
paragraphs: • Column A - Business Unit. The record is valid for all sub -groups when a Parent Group is selected. An empty cell is valid for any Business Unit
• Column B - Category. The record is valid for all sub -groups when a Parent Group is selected. An empty cell is valid for any Category
• Column C - Object Type. An empty cell is valid for any Object Type
• Columns D and E - Value Range (Minimum included and Maximum excluded)
• Column F - Approval Type. In order to use the Default Type enter '(default)'
• Columns from G to P - Approver User (in the correct order)
The import will completely replace the existing one. Records not present on the file will be deleted.

sections.title: Automation: Program Manager Task Utilization
paragraphs: • Approval - Setting up approvers and rules for approval of an object
• Object Creation - Creation of Auctions, RFIs, RFQs, Bid Collector, and Contracts
• Prerequisites and Dependencies – Ensuring the proper protocol is completed
• Evaluation – Preventing an object or process from progressing until proper evaluation has taken place
• Communication – Alerting project team members to project progression, critical information, and individual responsibilities.

sections.title: Automation: Program Management Configuration
paragraphs: Workflow – Where tasks are set up. Tasks are the actions the buyers must perform
Task Schedule – The planned timeline for task completion
Project Approver List – Used to define and manage approver lists for project -level task approvals

sections.title: Key Terms:
paragraphs: • Parent - A high level task type that can include one or more smaller Child Tasks.
• Child - Activities which must be performed at specific stages of the project workflow. Child tasks are organized under higher level Parent Tasks.
• Dependencies - Tasks that cannot start until the current task in a workflow is complete.
• Prerequisites - Tasks that must be completed before starting the current task in a workflow.
• Conditional – Tasks that may be selectively activated in a running project, or deactivated if not required. Parent tasks only.

sections.title: Automation: Assessment Workflow Transitions
paragraphs: • Buyer/Supplier Data Completed - mandatory Questions replied to by the Buyer or Supplier in the Forms associated to the Step must all be 100% complete.
• All Forms Sent To Supplier Returned – Forms issued to the Supplier for review and completion as part of the Step must have been received back from the Supplier.
• Allowed Assessment Statuses – allows the Transition to take place only if the Assessment is in one of the specific Assessment Statuses selected
• Allowed Internal Process Statuses (Category Assessments only) - allows the Transition to take place only if the Internal Process Status is in one of the specific Statuses selected.
• Allowed Supplier Statuses – allows the Transition to take place only if the Supplier Status is in one of the specific Statuses selected.
• Allowed Score Range (inclusive) – if the current Scorecard score is in the range defined

sections.title: Automation: Assessment Workflow Configuration
paragraphs: Segmentation – Used to divide suppliers into different cluster groups (e.g. Partner, Strategic, Core, etc )
Qualification – Used to measure supplier competency or adequacy
Risk – Used to evaluate the potential risk impact
Category – Used to document and manage a supplier evaluation process at a Category level.

paragraphs: Datamart is a data aggregation hub where chart - based reports, as well as detailed summary tables for individual metrics, may be displayed. A standard set of reports is activated per client needs and additional reports maybe be configured upon purchase.
